alt: Official POPOPO app promotional image showing two anime-style 3D avatar characters standing next to smartphones displaying video call screens, surrounded by floating cartoon mascots — a cat, panda, bear with a crown, and robot — against a bright blue background, with the POPOPO logo and Japanese text reading 'video calling without a camera'
story: POPOPO — launched March 2026, backed by 4chan founder Hiroyuki, Evangelion director Hideaki Anno, and musician GACKT as 'the last human-made social network in the AI era' — announced its shutdown on July 15, 2026, only six months after launch, with the team stating 'we failed spectacularly.'
why_funny: They declared war on AI with 'the last human social network,' then built an app where humans communicate exclusively through anime avatars called Holosuits, and it still collapsed in half a year.
